question: Are there elements, other than pitch, that can potentially result in out of key converted singing?
title: PitchNet: Unsupervised Singing Voice Conversion with Pitch Adversarial Network
answer_rationale: The document indicates that pitch is not the only factor affecting out-of-key converted singing; the quality of converted singing is also dependent on the musical expression and timbre similarity, and the difficulty in learning joint phonetic and pitch representation can lead to out-of-key results. Additionally, the paper proposes methods to improve pitch translation and manipulation, implying that other elements beyond pitch can influence key accuracy.
